2607.09324.title: Letting the Data Speak: Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections with AI
2607.09324.paper_summary: Identifying and assigning keywords at scale is a technical, practical, and ethical challenge for crowdsourced collections. This article reports the findings of the "Extracting Keywords from Crowdsourced Collections" project, which used the Their Finest Hour Online Archive, a crowdsourced Second World War digital collection hosted by the University of Oxford, as a case study. The project evaluated three Natural Language Processing approaches to automate keyword extraction: Named Entity Recognition, Keyword Extraction, and Topic Modelling. It tested these approaches across a range of artificial intelligence techniques, from traditional statistical methods to modern GenAI neural networks. Our quantitative and qualitative findings indicate that Natural Language Processing approaches offer real potential for keyword extraction at scale in crowdsourced collections, but that no single method offers a complete solution and that model choice significantly shapes results. We argue that in crowdsourced collections, where metadata is the direct product of engagement with living contributors, automated keyword extraction raises distinct stewardship responsibilities that must be addressed alongside technical performance. Open-weight, extractive models emerge from our evaluation as best placed to support responsible deployment, while generative AI, despite its abstractive potential, introduces accountability risks that anyone managing crowdsourced collections should weigh carefully.
2607.09324.paper_summary_zh: 識別和分配關鍵字在大規模上對於眾包收藏來說是一個技術性、實用性和倫理上的挑戰。這篇文章報告了“從眾包收藏中提取關鍵字”項目的研究結果，該項目以牛津大學主辦的眾包第二次世界大戰數字收藏——他們的最佳時刻在線檔案為案例研究。該項目評估了三種自然語言處理方法來自動化關鍵字提取：命名實體識別、關鍵字提取和主題建模。它測試了這些方法在一系列人工智能技術中的表現，從傳統的統計方法到現代的生成式人工智能神經網絡。我們的定量和定性研究結果表明，自然語言處理方法在眾包收藏中提供了大規模關鍵字提取的實際潛力，但沒有單一的方法能提供完整的解決方案，模型選擇對結果有顯著影響。我們認為，在眾包收藏中，元數據是與活躍貢獻者互動的直接產物，自動化關鍵字提取提出了獨特的管理責任，這必須與技術性能一起加以解決。我們的評估顯示，開放權重的提取模型最適合支持負責任的部署，而生成式人工智能儘管具備抽象潛力，但引入的問責風險是任何管理眾包收藏的人都應仔細考量的。
